name: Wayline
long_description:
A comprehensive system that sorts, sends, and solves issues so every request and booking gets handled immediately, letting you focus on what drives revenue.

Unify disconnected services and tools with a system that gives you humans where they're crucial and AI for everything else. Get instant, automatic, 24/7 replies for all the routine stuff, follow-ups that follow up on their own, and support from real people when you need it.
